slice: RPP-5ef immediate ENTITIES dispatch and callback observations

scope.api: Separate optional DRW_DxfEntitiesDeliveryHandler and additive source/limits/dispatch/event/callback/origin types; existing DRW_Interface, observer facet vtables and drawing-model layouts unchanged
scope.selection: Requires original physical ENTITIES source opt-in; delivery opt-in latched per actual section, no delivery report without physical opt-in
scope.identity: Exact real physical scope ID and initial/ENDSEC marker spans; no fabricated BLOCK owner
scope.dispatch: Actual processEntities(false) dispatch begin/end intervals, including compound subrecords consumed in one parse dispatch and dispatched no-callback records
scope.callbacks: Immediate forwarding, no queue or callback-value copies; const references, pointers, null and dynamic subtype preserved; actual begin/return/end observations not reconstruction from cData counts
scope.facets: TABLE/ATTDEF source facet wants/calls delegate independently to original target; source observer events separate from parser events
scope.projections: Target-internal TABLE-to-INSERT fallback is not another producer event
scope.proxy: Explicit exception-safe ProxyRendering scopes at both DXF raw and typed proxy decode call sites; restore Parser origin before typed/raw callbacks; no inference from handle or count
scope.completion: After accepted ENDSEC and physical source callback; contiguous dispatches, completed captured event prefix and matching Complete physical scope required
scope.exceptions: An earlier hook/ordinary/source exception leaves no final report; a throwing final report callback or later file failure invalidates whole-import use despite any observed Complete report
scope.accounting: Precharge report/lease/dispatch/event owners through shared retained-byte budget; own evidence allocation/quota failures soft, actual shared reader ceilings may reject read. Logical allowance not RSS/all allocators/strict CPU/leak certification
scope.contextRestoration: Local RAII restores original interface on accepted, failed and throwing exits; explicit proxy origin RAII
scope.drawings: All new inputs authored locally at runtime; unrelated local samples preserved
scope.completenessLimit: Metadata/actual invocation transport, not immutable modeled body, space/layout ownership, dependency targets, live/editable/output or native/kernel support proof
scope.metadataLimit: Event handles/owners are callback-model convenience values, not original wide handle lexemes or independent identity roles

owningControlsPerConfiguration.axes: Four modern versions x ASCII LF/CRLF/Binary
owningControlsPerConfiguration.allocationLimit: Environment-specific schedule, not all sites or portable STL counts; logical leases return to initial and zero after reader teardown
owningControlsPerConfiguration.facetAxes: Two encodings x TABLE source on/off x ATTDEF source on/off
owningControlsPerConfiguration.proxyLimit: Existing locally authored OP_CIRCLE framing for routing, not independent CAD/kernel semantics
owningControlsPerConfiguration.semanticsLimit: Unresolved references/mixed space metadata and no-callback rows deliberate; no complete CAD-validity or native consumer witness
